runner.note: Amended at amended_at_utc in response to review #53, which ruled that the frozen protocol's scoring section is the more specific instrument: malformed JSON, a non-array output and a missing output are scored as invalid_json, schema_or_parse_error or missing rather than aborting the run. Episode timeout, authorization, identity, frozen-digest, preflight and model-load failures remain stop conditions. configs/e01-protocol.md carries the matching erratum. The applied rule is recorded in every run record through RunPlan.to_record().

notes: The model block is asserted against results/R02/r02-smoke-001/ by scripts/e01_identity.py; it is not a new pin.
The episode and reference files are regenerated by scripts/e01_records.py from configs/e01-protocol.json before invocation and must match these hashes byte-for-byte.
The candidate manifest contains only the declared canonical records/primitive-operation surface; reference answers and scorer-side metadata remain separate.

prompt_sha256 is the SHA-256 over the rendered prompts for all 32 frozen episodes, in episode-manifest order, each terminated by one newline. It is committed and binding: scripts/e01_run.py recomputes it over the generated manifest and refuses on a mismatch before the preflight and before any model load. The instruction text alone is 249c60b70ec3ce4f7c5afa2e75db642c41317fa4c3fd39a64024f8c8078635a8 and is recorded alongside it.
prompt_renderer_revision and runner_revision were added by issue #24; the four fields present at 03:55:37Z are unchanged.
stop_on_malformed_output was flipped to false at amended_at_utc in response to review #53; test_e01_run.py asserts a full 32-generation completion with malformed rows scored.
Resource values remain UNSET until the authorized E01 run writes its manifest.
